answer: The tundra schedule is applied in ridge and pulse shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 40% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4444 identities would post 1423 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
